description: Dashboard + cam status reflect real per-story progress instead of the frozen stop-hook iter/since (MVP, 2 stories).

userStories.title: Supervisor keeps .claude/cam-loop.local.md live across iterations
userStories.description: As the dashboard/status reader, I need the loop state file to reflect the running story, completed count, and last activity per iteration (and to be cleared on terminal exit) so that liveness is observable instead of frozen at the values written once at cam-next start.
acceptanceCriteria: src/supervisor/loop.ts exposes an optional onProgress callback in RunSupervisorOptions; the loop invokes it at the top of each iteration (after decideNextAction resolves) with at least { iteration, currentStoryId, storiesDone, storiesTotal, lastActivity } and once more on each terminal exit (complete | awaiting-operator | blocked | max-iterations).
Absent onProgress = pure no-op; the existing loop tests in test/supervisor/loop.test.ts pass unchanged (backward compatible).

src/commands/next.ts wires a real onProgress that rewrites .claude/cam-loop.local.md with the live fields each iteration, and on terminal exit either unlinks the file or sets active:false so the dashboard never shows a stale 'active' after the run.

The state-file template (vendor/cam-loop.local.md.tmpl) and parseStateFile in src/commands/status.ts round-trip the new fields (current_story, stories_done, stories_total, last_activity); pre-existing fields (active, iteration, max_iterations, started_at, pid, session_id, completion_promise) keep working with no breaking shape change.
test/supervisor/loop.test.ts covers: onProgress called per iteration with the right story id + done/total counts; called once on each terminal status path; absent callback path unchanged.
test/next.test.ts (and/or a state-file-writer test) covers the real writer + clear-on-terminal-exit behavior.
Vendor drift check passes (bun run embed-vendor:check)
userStories.notes: Files: src/supervisor/loop.ts (add onProgress to RunSupervisorOptions; call at top of outer: while loop ~line 425 and on every terminal return); src/commands/next.ts (build callback, reuse writeStateFile/renderStateFile, add clear-on-exit; do NOT add a --permission-mode CLI flag); vendor/cam-loop.local.md.tmpl (extend frontmatter, re-embed); src/commands/status.ts parseStateFile (accept the new optional fields). Re-run `bun run embed-vendor` + `bun run embed-vendor:check` after touching vendor/. CAM-22 retired the stop-hook driver: the supervisor is now the only writer, so this is the only place to fix the source. Keep ported src/retry/* MIT headers intact (untouched here). Read-only readers (readSnapshot, parseStateFile) must never throw on missing fields: gate the new fields with `typeof === 'number'` checks and string presence, mirroring the existing pattern in readSnapshot ~line 404-410.

userStories.title: Dashboard + cam status render real per-story progress
userStories.description: As the operator watching the dashboard or running cam status, I need to see `running US-XXX (N/total)` plus a real last-activity timestamp instead of `iter X/max idle` so that I can tell whether real work is happening during the run.
acceptanceCriteria: src/commands/dashboard.ts readSnapshot pulls the new fields (current_story, stories_done, stories_total, last_activity) from the live state file; DashboardData gains the matching fields without breaking existing consumers; running vs idle is derived from the live state-file presence + active flag (idle = no file, running = file with active:true and a current_story, paused/done = file with active:false).

src/ui/Dashboard.tsx Loop section replaces the meaningless `iter N/max` (stop-hook turns) with `stories <done>/<total>` + the current story id; the `since/active` line uses last_activity when present, falling back to started_at. Ink convention upheld: success/failure is the ✓/✗ glyph, never the divider color.

src/commands/status.ts runStatus mirrors the same fields (current story id+title, stories N/total, state active|paused|idle, since/last_activity) so `cam status` shows the same real progress; cwd-only, never throws on missing fields.

test/dashboard.test.ts asserts the rendered Loop section shows stories-done/total + the current story id + running/idle correctly across three fixtures (no state file -> idle; live state-file mid-run -> running US-XXX (N/total); state-file with active:false -> paused/done).
test/status.test.ts asserts the rendered status output shows the same fields for the same three fixtures.
Verify the screen renders correctly (ink-testing-library snapshot of the Loop section; do not trust source comments — render and look at the real output, per the 2026-06-05 lesson).
userStories.notes: Files: src/commands/dashboard.ts (readSnapshot ~line 356-414; extend DashboardData; map new state fields), src/ui/Dashboard.tsx (Loop section; find the existing `SummaryRow label=\"iter\"` that renders `iter ${data.iteration}/${data.maxIterations}` by symbol, not line number, since lines drift), src/commands/status.ts (runStatus + parseStateFile output rendering). Depends on US-001 (the new state-file fields must exist before the UI can render them). Skills: Ink TUI rendering (`src/design/tokens.ts`, `src/ui/theme.ts`), ink-testing-library for the render assertion. Gotchas: readSnapshot and buildStatusReport are read-only and MUST NOT throw on missing/old-shape state files — keep the typeof guards and existing fallback-to-defaults pattern; do not introduce a divider-color signal for success/failure (project convention: glyph only).
